newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Yakutia says plans several Eurobond issues.
newsitem.headline: Russia Yakutia says plans several Eurobond issues.

text.p: Russia's diamond-producing Sakha republic (Yakutia) plans to tap international capital markets with several Eurobond issues, a local government official said on Tuesday.
"We are planning several Eurobond issues," deputy government chairman Sergei Yanygin told Reuters. "The first issue will be a short one, but later we want to extend maturities."
Yanygin said the republic would soon choose credit rating agencies and by the end of June would choose lead managers. He refused to mention the volume or the timing of the issue.
He said the region received funding from the federal government. A draft law on regional Eurobond issues prohibits regions which receive money from the federal government from issuing Eurobonds.
But First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais recommended Yakutia to get a credit rating when he visited the republic last month.
Many Russian regions and cities plan to issue Eurobonds. The City of Moscow last week placed $500 million of Eurobonds at a spread of 315 basis points over U.S.Treasuries.
